description: This file defines the QueueCacheMissException class, a custom exception used within the Orleans.Streams namespace to indicate that a requested message is not in the queue cache. It includes constructors, properties for sequence tokens, and serialization support.

classes.name: QueueCacheMissException
classes.description: A sealed class representing an exception thrown when a requested cache item is missing in the queue cache. It extends DataNotAvailableException and includes properties for sequence tokens and serialization support.

methods.description: Default constructor initializing the exception with a default message.

methods.description: Constructor accepting a message and an inner exception.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with sequence tokens, converting them to strings.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with string representations of sequence tokens and setting properties.
